Default.tutOverviewText: Everyone sees a trivia question with 3 possible answers. Some of the players are secretly Sneaks - they know the identities of the other Sneaks. The Sneaks already know the correct answer to the question, and are trying to get as many Travelers (i.e. non-Sneak players) as possible to guess the wrong answer.
Default.tutBeaconText: Every round, one Traveler is randomly chosen to be the Beacon of Light. Everyone knows this player is the Beacon (and that this player can therefore NOT be a Sneak).
Default.tutPickingText: Before the 2-minute timer runs out, everyone must click on one of the possible answers. Everyone's guesses are then shown simultaneously, and the correct answer is revealed.
Default.tutScoringText: Sneaks get 10 points per non-Sneak player who guessed incorrectly. Travelers get 10 points per Traveler (including the Beacon) who guessed correctly.
Default.tutWinningText: You can stop the game after any number of questions. The winner is the player with the most points! We recommend playing to 100.
